description: Return the entire free corpus as one document (every free resource title, description, canonical URL, and full Markdown body) — the same content as /llms-full.txt. Premium resources appear as a stub with a purchase link, not their body. Use this to ingest everything in a single call; the response is large. Optional `category` returns only that category's resources (smaller result).

category.description: Only resources in this category (case-insensitive): Guide, Policy, Reference, Meta. Omit for the whole corpus.

name: get_corpus
title: Get free corpus
